Q9015.reason: Metabolic reactions are catalyzed by enzymes, which are proteins whose synthesis the genetic material directs.

Q9017.reason: Under the lien-theory majority view, a mortgage by one joint tenant is only a lien that does not sever the joint tenancy, so the survivor takes free of it on the borrower's death.

Q9018.reason: Many courts treat two years of continued at-will employment after signing a noncompete as adequate consideration, though this is not uniform across jurisdictions.
